newsitem.title: USA: A. Schulman sees improving qtly earnings.
newsitem.headline: A. Schulman sees improving qtly earnings.

text.p: A. Schulman said on Thursday it expected its quarterly earnings would continue to improve from the year ago periods, despite continuing margin pressure in the North American automotive market.
The company reported first quarter to November 30 earnings rose to $0.32 per share from $0.23 per share a year earlier.

"The improvement in first quarter earnings was in line with our plan," President and Chief Executive Officer Terry Haines said. "Currently we have a solid level of orders and overall, business is relatively good."
The company said the large increase in first quarter earnings was the result of strong demand for its products and better profit margins in its manufacturing operations.

Sales were up due to a 12.6 percent increase in tonnage, which was partially offset by a 3.5 percent adverse foreign currency translation impact and a 5.8 percent reduction resulting from lower prices and product mix, it said.
A. Schulman supplies plastic compounds and resins.
